params.body:
## Why

Two advisories were published on 2026-09-30 for `league/commonmark` <= 2.10.1, the version in our lock:

- [GHSA-97jj-33gv-5xf9](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-97jj-33gv-5xf9) (medium): bypass of the `DisallowedRawHtml` extension.
- [GHSA-3q6v-r5mr-hxv8](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3q6v-r5mr-hxv8) (high): quadratic-time denial of service in the GFM table extension.

Since then the CI job "Dependencies carry no new advisory" (`composer audit --locked`) fails on every pull request.

## What

`league/commonmark` 2.10.1 to 2.10.3 in `composer.lock`, nothing else. It is a transitive dependency (through `laravel/framework`), so `composer.json` does not change. The update was run as `composer update league/commonmark` without `--with-dependencies`; with that flag `symfony/polyfill-php80` would also have moved (1.37.0 to 1.43.0), which 2.10.3 does not need (`^1.16`), so it stays.

Where commonmark runs in the platform: the markdown mailables (`$this->markdown(...)` in `app/Mail/*`, whose Laravel renderer enables the table extension) and `Str::markdown` in `DocsController` for the pages under `docs/`.

## Checks

- `composer audit --locked`: no advisories.
- Related tests (docs pages, docs vs routes, LYRA's doc chatbot, compiled views, invitation, bidding, error and second-factor mails): 45 tests, 166 assertions, green.
- Full suite locally: 2508 tests, 18225 assertions, green (1 skipped, 1 incomplete).
- PHPStan: no errors.

No business rule changes.
params.title: Bump league/commonmark to 2.10.3 for two advisories
